bug_semantics: The unauthenticated GET /api/session-summary and GET /api/session-events handlers accepted req.query.sessionId and interpolated it into path.join(hooksDataPath, `session-log-${sessionId}.jsonl`) without validation or containment checking. A sessionId containing a slash followed by .. segments caused Node path normalization to resolve outside the intended hooks data directory; existsSync and readFileSync then disclosed any process-readable .jsonl file at the resolved path.
flaw_origin: Commit 051f27474d85d7f3299b56fc61bfcb0666a4e198 created src/server/web-server.ts and introduced both vulnerable routes as one feature. It added only CORS, JSON-body, and static-file middleware before the routes, took sessionId from the query string, constructed both filesystem paths directly from it, and read those paths without an allowlist, authentication middleware, or a resolved-path containment check.
